    # Check if we can find a suffix that is greater than its previous character
    for i in range(n - 2, -1, -1):
        if s[i] > s[i + 1]:

            for j in range(n - 1, i, -1):

def find_reversible_substring(s):
    n = len(s)
    
    # Check for the longest increasing suffix starting from the end
    i = n - 1
    while i > 0 and s[i-1] <= s[i]:
        i -= 1
    
    # If no such suffix exists, reversing any substring will not work
    if i == 0:
        return "NO"
    
    # Find the rightmost character that is smaller than s[i]
    j = n - 1
    while s[j] >= s[i-1]:
        j -= 1
    
    # Return the indices for the substring to reverse
    return f"Yes\n{i} {j+1}"

def reverse_substring_to_make_smaller(s):
    n = len(s)
    # Find the longest non-decreasing suffix starting from the end
    i = n - 1
    while i > 0 and s[i - 1] <= s[i]:
        i -= 1
    
    # If the whole string is non-decreasing, it's impossible to make it smaller
    if i == 0:
        return "NO"
    
    # Find the rightmost character in the decreasing part that is greater than the character before the non-decreasing suffix
    j = n - 1
    while j >= i and s[j] <= s[i - 1]:
        j -= 1
    
    # Reverse the substring [i-1, j+1]
    return f"YES\n{i} {j+1}"
